notes.title: Master of the Tattooverse NEW YEAR UPDATE
notes.content:
[h2]Merry Christmas to all apprentices in Tattooverse![/h2]

We're spreading the holiday cheer by having a big update on Master of the Tattooverse.

This update includes some bug fixes and improvements, as well as a few new features that we hope you will enjoy.

Plus, there are some new tattoo guns and tools to discover, as well as better gameplay!

[b]Here are the details!:

[list]
[*] 4 New Tattoo guns added! Three of them have already been added to Racky, you need to search a little for the other one. [Spoiler] Nope, there is no hint here [/spoiler]

[*] Hand size can be changed from Racky.

[*] Further optimizations were added for a smoother gameplay experience.

[*] Some minor bug fixes.

[*]A new year sale is here for a week!
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Valve Index Support & Screenshot Save | Small Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We noticed that Valve Index users have a controller location problem. Thanks to all of you for your feedback. We changed the controller location and rotations for Valve Index. Don't forget to try other grip presets from the Accessibility menu!

Also changed the in-game screenshots' save location to access easily. You can find your in-game screenshots from this path "[b]C:\Users\[i]-YOUR USER NAME-[/i]\Pictures[/b]".  It is basically windows' default Pictures folder on your computer.

[h2][b]Update Contents[/b][/h2]
[b][list]
[*]Controller location, rotation and grip fixes for Valve Index.
[*]Screenshot save location changed to "C:\Users\[i]-YOUR USER NAME-[/i]\Pictures".
[*]Backend system for VR Headset supports changed with improved version.
[/list][/b]

tags.bug: [*]Controller location, rotation and grip fixes for Valve Index.

tags.feature: [*]Screenshot save location changed to "C:\Users\[i]-YOUR USER NAME-[/i]\Pictures".
[*]Backend system for VR Headset supports changed with improved version.

notes.title: Audio Clip Improvements | Hotfix V1.0.25
notes.content:
We found that in some cases audio clips cause crashes. To prevent this error we optimized audio clips and changed our loading methods. 

[b][u]Fix and Changes[/u][/b]
[b][list]
[*]Audio clip loading system changed.
[*]Audio clips optimized.
[/list][/b]

[b]About future fixes[/b]

We already know the problem with Valve Index controllers we are working on it. Also, we are looking for a fix for Klaudia's (our vampire client) texture seam problem. We are going to fix the issues and update you as soon as possible.

notes.title: DLL Fix | Hotfix v1.0.21
notes.content: We noticed some VR Headsets had problems with changing scene sequences. We thank our players who reach us with that issue.  We find the problem related to a specific DLL. This hotfix solves this issue and prevents players get a black screen on loadings and scene changes.

tags.bug: This hotfix solves this issue and prevents players get a black screen on loadings and scene changes.

notes.title: Tattoo Load Improvements | Hotfix V1.0.19
notes.content:
As we mentioned in the last update Master of the Tattooverse is also designed to be playable on standalone VR headsets without a PC. When we find anything to upgrade in a small time we are adding this to our game and post an update. This minor update is for changing the system a bit to improve performance between scene changes and tattoo loading.

[b][list]
[*]Tattoo loading system improved.
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Visual Improvements | Hotfix V1.0.13b
notes.content:
Master of the Tattooverse is also designed for to be playable on standalone VR headsets without a PC. That's why we always targeted the minimum system load. We decided even the minimum PC systems -which support VR- can handle more. We are happy to say we improved our visual more for the PC-supported VR. 

[b][list]
[*] Anti-Aliasing Quality Increased.
[*] Texture Quality Increased.
[*] Tattoo Texture Quality Increased.
[/list][/b]
